summary: Completed public API and browser testing for the Kocaeli Gaziantep Mutfağı menu site. Menu, delivery, filters, phone, WhatsApp order payload, branding, and mobile navigation passed.
action_items: Normalize generated category data-testid values (especially Turkish dotted İ) so automation can target them reliably without falling back to visible text.
critical_code_review_comments: Category test IDs are generated with toLowerCase() on Turkish labels, producing a combining-dot form for İ; this caused the initial selector timeout and weakens testability even though the visible controls work.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public menu and delivery APIs plus desktop/mobile UI flows are covered. Final browser run passed 36-item rendering, category filtering, product WhatsApp payload, phone href, Kadıköy/unknown delivery responses, and mobile menu toggling. No auth or payment flow exists.
rca of the issue: The initial browser selector timeout was caused by the test using an assumed ASCII data-testid for 'Hamur İşi'. App.js derives IDs using category.toLowerCase().replaceAll(' ', '-'); JavaScript lowercasing of capital dotted İ does not produce the same ASCII selector spelling. Visible-role selectors work, and this is a testability issue rather than a user-facing failure.
